stem: A round cake with a radius of 10 centimeters is cut into 8 equal slices, as shown. What is the length, in centimeters, of the curved edge of one slice?
solution: The curved edges of all 8 slices make up the whole circumference, \(2\pi(10) = 20\pi\).

explanation.B: Incorrect. This is \(\frac{1}{8} \cdot \pi(10)^{2}\), the area of the top of one slice, not the length of its edge.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is the circumference of the whole cake; it still has to be divided by 8.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This uses a radius of 5, treating 10 as the diameter: \(\frac{2\pi(5)}{8} = \frac{5\pi}{4}\).

verify:
choices = {o: choices[n] for o, n in {'B': 'A', 'C': 'B', 'D': 'C', 'A': 'D'}.items()}; answer = {'A': 'B', 'B': 'C', 'C': 'D', 'D': 'A'}[answer]  # shuffled: original letters
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert d('O','P')==10 and abs(d('O','Q')-10)<0.01 and abs(ang('P','O','Q')-45)<0.1
ans=2*pi*10/8
assert simplify(value(choices[answer])-ans)==0
assert all(simplify(value(choices[k])-ans)!=0 for k in choices if k!=answer)
